home.feature1Desc: Dialogflow NLP chatbot available 24/7 for instant guest support, booking assistance and multilingual communication.

home.feature6Desc: Comprehensive review system capturing multilingual guest sentiment to improve services and build long-term loyalty.
home.review1Text: Outstanding AI recommendations led us to hidden gems we never would have found. Perfect Sri Lanka experience!
home.review2Text: The multilingual support in Hindi made everything so easy. Booking was smooth and the hotels were spectacular.

vision.title: Vision & Mission
vision.sub: Building the most intelligent and inclusive hotel management platform for Sri Lanka's tourism future
vision.visionText: To become Sri Lanka's leading AI-powered hospitality platform — connecting global travellers with the island's finest hotels through intelligent technology, personalised experiences and sustainable practices that benefit local communities.
vision.missionText: To design and develop an AI-driven web-based hotel management system integrating analytics, prediction models, automation workflows and AI assistance into a unified platform that enhances hotel operations and elevates guest satisfaction for hotels and travellers worldwide.
vision.objectivesSub: The six pillars that guide HotelEco Pro's development and impact
vision.goal1Desc: Dialogflow NLP, GPT automation and ML predictive models integrated into a single cohesive hospitality platform.
vision.goal2Desc: Mapbox GL JS delivering personalised nearby destination suggestions and real-time navigation for every guest.
vision.goal3Desc: Analytics dashboards empowering hotel administrators with actionable demand forecasting and sentiment insights.
vision.goal4Desc: Multilingual support welcoming travellers from India, China, Japan, Russia, Europe and beyond with native language interfaces.
vision.goal5Desc: Eco-conscious hotel management reducing administrative overhead and promoting sustainable Sri Lankan tourism practices.
vision.goal6Desc: Integrated review systems, automated messaging and AI concierge services to maximise guest satisfaction and loyalty.
